ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region across ~75% of surface. High-contrast white patch located on the distal right lobe containing a dark hook-shaped pixel cluster. Secondary mottled white region located on the medial-distal portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with a calculated wide angle exceeding 120 degrees; depth is minimal relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (notches) along the left trailing edge. Right trailing edge exhibits more uniform, lower-amplitude peak-and-valley topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges transitioning to sharp, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-intensity white pixel clusters at the extreme tips of both lobes and at the peaks of several trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel vertical dark linear disruptions visible on the lower-central region of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation on the left trailing edge; distinctive hook-shaped dark mark isolated within the right lobe's white pigmentation patch.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe white patch contains a specific circular 'eye' or 'hook' pigmentation pattern that is highly localized and distinct from the surrounding white gradient.
